From my experience, the submission evaluation depends on the number of test datasets and the complexity of the tracking pipeline. The sample submission has a fairly small number of entries, so scoring should be relatively quick (minutes, not hours). If your submission is still pending after 30 minutes, check if the format matches the sample_submission.csv exactly.
